title: Gridfire
summary: Two-thumb arena shooter: eight sectors, power-ups, upgrades and an endless mode
description:
**Gridfire** is a fast arena shooter for two thumbs. You fly a small ship around a square arena on a grid of light that ripples and bends under every shot and blast. No ads, no account, no tracking.

**Playing**

- **Two thumbs, anywhere.** Put a thumb down on the left half of the screen and drag to fly. Drag on the right half to aim: your ship fires for as long as that thumb stays down. The sticks appear wherever you touch.
- **One-thumb mode** lets the ship aim and fire at the nearest enemy by itself, so you only steer.
- **Eight sectors of six waves.** Each sector ends in a surge, and clearing it opens the next. The first five each bring in a new kind of enemy, from seekers that chase you to dodgers that slip aside from your bullets and gravity wells that pull your shots and your ship toward them.
- **Endless mode** opens once you have cleared Sector 2: the waves keep coming and keep getting faster.
- **Score and multiplier.** Destroyed enemies drop shards. Fly through them to raise your multiplier up to ×10, which also widens your fire from two streams to a five-way spread. Losing a ship resets it.
- **Bombs** clear every enemy on the field. You start with three ships and three bombs, and earn more as your score grows.
- **Power-ups and upgrades.** Gold-ringed elites drop capsules with six power-ups: ricochet, piercing and homing shots, drones, time warp and a shield. After waves 1, 3 and 5 (every second wave in Endless) you pick one of three upgrades, such as side cannons, chain lightning or bombs that recharge, and they stack for the rest of the run.
- **A guide built in.** How to play explains the controls, the scoring, every power-up and upgrade, and each enemy.

**Your game and your scores**

- The run in progress is saved as you play, so you can close the app and continue where you left off. The game pauses itself when you leave it.
- After every run: your score, kills, top multiplier and time, and the best score for each sector and for Endless.
- Progress and settings stay on your phone. Erase progress starts the sectors over and keeps your settings.

**Sound and looks**

- Every sound is synthesised as you play, and the music is a live sequencer that builds up with each wave. Sound effects, music and volume each have their own setting.
- Glowing vector graphics. Where a phone can't use the faster graphics, the game draws in a plainer style, and Auto quality lowers the resolution if the frame rate drops.
- The home screen is a live arena: tap the empty grid to make it ring.
- Light and dark designs, or follow the phone. Reduce motion calms the grid and removes screen shake, flashes and blinking; it follows your phone's setting unless you choose otherwise.
- With a keyboard and mouse: WASD to move, the arrow keys or the mouse to aim and fire, Space for a bomb, P to pause. Waves, lost ships, bombs and power-ups are announced to screen readers.

**What it never does**

- No ads, no in-app purchases, no locked features.
- No account and no sign-in.
- No internet access: the game works offline and cannot connect anywhere.
- No analytics or tracking of any kind.
